text:
Brady Tkachuk's first season in Florida after the trade from Ottawa is going loudly. He has 10 goals and 20 points in 18 games, and 14 of those points have come on the power play. He has 67 shots on goal and 69 hits, which is about as Brady Tkachuk as a stat line gets.

The process backs it up. His 8.8 expected goals sit close to his 10 goals, so this isn't a hot-shooting mirage, and the Panthers take 60% of the shot attempts at 5-on-5 with him on. By our wins-added measure he ranks 7th of 506 skaters. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flagged a signature last season: 19% of his setups come from behind the net, more than double a typical forward.

The trade still trails him. theScore carried his father Keith's line, "It's time Ottawa moves on," and HockeyFeed asked whether Brian Burke had called out both brothers. On the ice, the worry is narrow: if the power play cools, the scoring follows. He's on a 4-game point streak.
headline: Brady Tkachuk has made Florida's power play his
